advisoryCouncil.name: Dr. Sharad Onta
bio: Present position

Dr. Sharad Onta, a medical graduate (MD) in 1984 from Leningrad – former Soviet Union (USSR), has master degree in public health (MPH) from UK in 1992. He completed Ph D in 1999 from Copenhagen, Denmark in health system research.
Retired faculty of Tribhuvan University, Nepal
He is founding General Secretary of Nepal Public Health Foundation (NPHF).
Chair, Resource Centre for Primary Health Care, an NGO
President, Physicians for Social Responsibility Nepal (PSRN)
Country Coordinator, People’s Health Movement, Nepal
Previous positions

Dr. Onta was Professor and Head of the Department of Community Medicine and Public Health of Institute of Medicine, Tribhuvan University, Kathmandu. His responsibilities included teaching International Health to MPH students, supervising public health master and Ph D students. He was a Member of Academic Council of Tribhuvan University, Member of Academic Council of National Academy of Medical Sciences (NAMS) and Patan Academy of Health Sciences (PAHS).

Dr. Onta worked as Executive Director of a National NGO – Resource Centre for Primary Health Care during 1992-1994.  In 2007, he was nominated by the Government of Nepal as Executive Member Secretary of Nepal Health Research Council, an authority to approve and monitor health research activities in Nepal. He was also nominated by the Government of Nepal as Executive Chief of HIV/AIDS and STI Control Board in 2009. He was a member of High Level Policy Advisory Body at the Ministry of Health and Population (2007-209).
Dr. Onta served as a Senator of BP Memorial Institute of Health Sciences, a Deemed University under the Ministry of Health and Population during 2007-2009.
Dr. Onta was Assistant Dean (Academic) of the Institute of Medicine, responsible for academic activities of the institute from 2012 to 2016.
Health policy

He is extensively involved in development of national health policies, planning and strategies. Dr. Onta contributed to development of national compact for International Health Partnership (IHP). His contribution has been remarkable in development of National Action Plan of HIV AIDS, implement Framework Convention of Tobacco Control (FCTC) in the country, formulate strategy of revitalization of primary health care, develop and implement public health education.

He worked as a member of High Level Health Policy Development Committee (2017), formed by Council of Ministers for development of a new National Health Policy in the context of federalization of the country. His particular interest is in health finance system to address equity in health.
Networking

He has a wide links with several regional and international networks and has experiences of working in other countries. His involvement in People’s Health Movement at the regional and global level has visibly added voice to strategize social determinants of health. Dr. Onta is among the activist physicians to advocate for “peace through health”, as an International Councillor of Physicians for Social Responsibility, Nepal (PSRN), an affiliate to International Physicians for Prevention of Nuclear War (IPPNW). He is an active member of People’s Health Movement, Nepal Chapter to advocate in health right issues.
Publications
Dr. Onta has published several research articles in national and international journals, produced several reports and contributed to chapters of several books.

advisoryCouncil.name: Dr. Shreeranjan
bio: Dr Shreeranjan had long and distinguished career of 32 years in the Indian Administrative Service and held key positions of responsibility and leadership in various departments and Ministries in both the State Government and Government of India. He was also Joint Secretary for 5 years in the Ministry of Woman and Child Development and was responsible for policy formulation and implementation of government programmes pertaining to child development and child rights, nutrition, early childhood care and education, women empowerment, international cooperation, etc. He also served for about 2 years as Joint Secretary and Additional Secretary to the Govt. of India as Deputy Director General (DDG) in the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), and was also empanelled as Secretary to Government of India. He also served as Chairman, Board of Revenue and Additional Chief Secretary in Government of Meghalaya, and also as Chairman of Meghalaya Biodiversity Board. He has also participated in several prestigious international and national conferences, representing the Country in international forums relating to women and child development and was also awarded National E-Governance Award in 2014.

He also has to his credit for having contributed and authored several books, important reports, research publications relating to a large spectrum of topics including child development. He has also contributed extensively and edited the first ever State Development Report (SDR) and Human Development Report for the State of Meghalaya. He was member convenor of two working Groups of Planning Commission of India, on Child Rights and Nutrition for the 12th Plan and finalised the reports. Having his schooling from the famous Netarhat School, he is a Postgraduate in Botany apart from being a Postgraduate in Management and Implementation of Development Projects (Manchester University, U.K.) besides holding a Ph. D in Biotechnology. Prior to joining IAS in 1985, he was part of the academia having served as Assistant Professor/ Lecturer in Botany for four years in Ranchi University. Currently, he is Director, Eastern Regional Centre, of Institute for Human Development (IHD).

advisoryCouncil.name: Mr. Prabal Chakraborty
bio: Prabal Chakraborty was the Vice President and Managing Director of Boston Scientific India Private Ltd for over 7 years. He comes with a rich experience of over 27 years in Medical Device industry. His forte lies in launching new businesses, leading large teams and developing leadership pipeline. He has led BSCI in setting the vision, strategy and launch of the Powered To Win Strategy. He held several leadership positions in different industry bodies and helped in shaping the healthcare environment in India : Chairman of the Medical Device Committee of American Chamber of Commerce in India (AMCHAM), Co-Chair of Confederation of Indian Industry (CII), Indian Advisory Council Member of U.S.-India Business Council (USIBC), and Director at Medical Technology Association of India (MTAI). Additionally, he was also an active member of other bodies like FICCI, AdvaMed & NATHEALTH.

His previous assignment was Vice President, Johnson & Johnson Medical Devices & Diagnostics, India. He led Ethicon, Ethicon Endo Surgery and Cordis franchises and expanded their footprint in India. As part of the worldwide marketing team, he developed global launch plans for the Cypher drug eluting stent. In 2002, he moved to Singapore and provided strategic leadership to J&J’s Cordis Asia Pacific franchise for a period of 5 years.
At present, Prabal is working as Healthcare Advisor to corporates and start up ventures. He is also a Managing Partner in Ikizia Advisors.
Prabal holds a Bachelor of Electrical Engineering from Jadavpur University, Kolkata, India and an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow, India.

advisoryCouncil.name: Mr. Suneel Kumar Muttoo
bio: Born, brought up and educated at Delhi, Shri Suneel Kumar Muttoo took his Masters in History from Delhi University in 1975. He was selected for the Indian Administrative Service, which he joined in July 1977 and was allotted to the Uttar Pradesh State Cadre.

Shri Muttoo served in the Government of Uttar Pradesh at various locations – Bareilly, Ballia, Varanasi, Lucknow, Pilibhit and Allahabad in various capacities – notably, magisterial and revenue administration, industrial development, cooperatives,  district administration, civic administration, stamps and registration, sericulture promotion and management of a public sector undertaking dealing in supply of agriculture inputs to farmers.

On formation of the new State of Uttarakhand, Shri Muttoo worked in the Departments of Women Empowerment and Child Development, Social Welfare, Revenue, Disaster Management, Culture and Charitable Affairs as Secretary, Principal Secretary and Additional Chief Secretary. He was the State’s Chief Resident Commissioner at Delhi and Chairman of the Board of Revenue when he retired in 2014.

Shri Muttoo worked twice in the Central Government, once as Deputy Secretary and Director in the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances in the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, where, among other duties, he edited the newsletter ‘Civil Service News’ , the bulletin “Bulletin of Administrative Intelligence” and the journal “Management in Government” and again as Director, National Institute of Public Cooperation and Child Development under the Department of Women and Child Development then in the Ministry of Human Resource Development.

Shri Muttoo has worked as Observer for the Election Commission of India performing duties in remote and difficult areas like Barmer, Rajasthan; Nellore, Andhra Pradesh; Begusarai, Bihar; Aizwal, Mizoram (twice); Kannur, Kerala; Bolangir, Odisha; Nowrangpur, Odisha; South Tripura, Tripura. He has also worked as State Election Observer for Municipal and Block Panchayat Elections in Moradabad (Uttar Pradesh).

Between 2006 and 2010, Shri Muttoo worked outside the Government heading the USAID micronutrient project in India (with State teams in Jharkhand and Uttar Pradesh). He was also the Country Director for India for AI.COMM, the USAID Global Avian Influenza Behaviour Change and Communication project, which carried out communication activities in parts of Bihar, West Bengal and Tripura on behalf of the Department of Animal Husbandry, Dairying and Fisheries, Ministry of Agriculture, Government of India. In addition, he was the Country Coordinator for the H2P initiative on pandemic influenza communication and Country Coordinator for PREVENT, the USAID global project to develop and implement effective behaviour change and communications interventions that reduce the risk of emerging zoonotic diseases.

advisoryCouncil.name: Ms. Wardak
bio: Miriam Wardak joined Interos in February of 2020 as Senior Vice President, Human Resources to establish the company’s talent framework for a sustainable scale-up operation.

Wardak is a talent focused executive with experience in leading Human Resources teams in public and private sectors to deliver results, optimize organizational performance and maximize engagement. Wardak joins Interos as a proven leader in building start-ups, enabling growth within pre-IPO, post-IPO and Fortune 500 companies. Most recently Wardak was leading the People’s  Operation function at Repairify Inc. a hyper-growth company located in Plano, Texas. Prior to this, at Project HOPE, a global health development organization, Wardak was responsible for Finance, IT, Human Resources and Facilities operations. Prior leadership roles included  the head of HR role at ICF International, a Washington DC-based government consulting organization with over $500M in annual revenue and as Senior Vice President of Human Resources at i2 Technologies, a supply chain software company in Dallas, Texas.

Miriam was born in Kabul, Afghanistan, grew up in Germany, and has been living in the United States since 1990. She is fluent in German and Farsi and conversational in Italian and French. Miriam holds a B.A. from George Mason University and an M.B.A. from the University of Dallas.

advisoryCouncil.name: Ms. Cheena Malhotra
bio: Ms. Malhotra is a passionate public health professional with 18+ years international experience as a senior professional in public health working in both the private and public sectors. Ms. Malhotra has extensive experience in advocacy, policy reform and health systems strengthening with a particular focus on expanding access to healthcare services in India and abroad. Ms. Malhotra’s work across the globe including India, Bangladesh, Suriname, Mexico, Dubai, South Sudan is focused on non communicable diseases , nutrition, WASH, Solid Waste management and rare diseases has resulted in increased state funding for NCDs, the development of NCD training manuals for CHWs, Medical Officers and Para Medicals, monitoring of vaccination programs and  key improvements in the national Rare Disease Policy. Ms Malhotra is a post graduate and certified diabetes educator and lactation consultant. She has completed South East Asia regional course on public health by AIIMS Delhi and PGI Chandigarh. She has also completed her fellowship in global policy, diplomacy and sustainability

advisoryCouncil.name: Prof. Prashant Yadav
bio: Prof. Prashant Yadav is a globally recognized scholar in the area of healthcare supply chains. He is the author of many peer-reviewed scientific publications and his work has also been featured in prominent print and broadcast media including The Economist, The Financial Times, Nature, and BBC.

Outside academia, Yadav works closely with governments and global organizations in the area of policy and investment strategy design for healthcare supply chains. He currently works as Strategy Leader-Supply Chain at the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Yadav serves on the advisory boards of many global organizations and social enterprises. He has been invited for expert testimony on the issue of medicine supply chains in the US Congress and legislative bodies in other countries. He was a Commissioner on the Lancet Commission on Essential Medicines and has been a member of multiple national Academy of Medicine Expert Committees. He was Chair of the Market Dynamics Advisory Group of the Global Fund to fight AIDS, TB and Malaria, Geneva and Co-chair of Procurement and Supply Chain Management at the Roll Back Malaria Partnership.

Prof. Prashant’s research papers have been the recipient of the best paper awards from the Production and Operations Management Society, INFORMS, and other professional societies. He was inducted as a Chartered Fellow of the CILT in 2011.

Before his current role, Yadav was Vice President of Healthcare at the William Davidson Institute at the University of Michigan and a faculty member at the Ross School of Business at the University of Michigan. Before that he was Professor of Supply Chain Management at the MIT-Zaragoza International Logistics Program and a Research Affiliate at the MIT Center for Transportation and Logistics.

advisoryCouncil.name: Dr. Anoop Khandelwal
bio: Dr. Anoop Khandelwal is a supply chain and management professional with over 35 years’ working experience in the industry in India and overseas. On the education front, he is a Mechanical Engineer and Gold medallist from Agra University. He is also a post-graduate in Production Management and an alumnus of the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad. He is also a Ph.D. with research in Sustainability imperatives in the road transportation area. Beginning his career with HCL, in Office Automation and IT space, he worked there for about 10 years as General Manager and Plant-head. Thereafter, after a brief stint in the Textiles industry, in Vardhman Spinning Mills as VP Operations, he moved to Hewlett Packard (HP) as India Supply Chain & Logistics Head. As a Senior Director Operations in HP, he oversaw its growth in India as a premier Printer and IT company. He headed the entire Logistics and transportation function of the company handling imports and distribution. During his over ten years innings in HP, he also helped set up India back -office hub to manage Sales operations for entire Asia-Pacific region for HP. Post HP, he joined UTStarcom, a mid-size USA and China telecom MNC, as the designated Chief Operations Officer heading the Commercial and Operations functions to manage the rollout of Telecom infrastructure in Landline telephony space in India. He directly managed the execution and rollout of multi-play telephony equipment of BSNL across more than 500 locations in India. He joined Becton Dickinson India (BD) Operations team to address cost optimization initiatives in Supply Chain operations handling one of the largest projects of Distribution Network optimization which involved building modern warehouse infrastructure and efficient transportation using recent tools and trends in Logistics and Supply Chain space. Dr. Khandelwal is currently running his start-up Kspire Solutions LLP as Co-founder and CEO providing online mentoring services, project consultancy for commercial ventures, and supply chain interventions in public health supply chain arena.

advisoryCouncil.name: Dr. Gayatri Mishra Oleti
bio: Gayatri M Oleti, Joint General Manager, at present Heading Operations for Larsen & Toubro Public Charitable Trust. She holds a Ph. D degree in Population Studies, MBA, Xavier Institute of Management, Bhubaneswar India, MSC, Social Policy and Planning, London School of Economics. Gayatri implemented large scale public health programmes supported by USAID, World Bank and DFID, Gates Foundation and Children Investment Fund Foundation-UK in reproductive, sexual, maternal and child health domain. At present she is leading a multifunctional team and managing 300 Cr portfolio of L&T Public Charitable Trust to reach out to five million beneficiaries across five states in India with comprehensive development programmes with focus in access to primary a health care and education. Gayatri’s covers a wide range in social sector i.e. public health, system strengthening, improving access to primary care, livelihood, education, digital and financial inclusions leading to comprehensive community development.

advisoryCouncil.name: Dr. Neeru Johri
bio: Professor Dr. Neeru Johri, Head, Department of Media Communication Studies at JIMS, Vasant Kunj, blends more than two decades of experience both in academics, social sector and industry. She also has experience of working in the Social Sector for more than a decade in area of Behaviour Change Communication and Policy Formulation related to Maternal Child Health Nutrition and Delaying Age of Marriage in Jharkhand with both the Government and International Organizations (USAID funded projects, CARE, DFID, UNICEF). She has contributed actively in designing of Training Modules on Life Skills for Adolescent Girls, Reproductive Health, Counseling, and Skilled Birth Attendant and advocacy forums. She has also been a Compeer with AIR & Doordarshan. Dr. Neeru Johri is also the Managing Editor of Mass Communicator: International Journal of Communication Studies since 2012. She is also in-charge for generation of content for Radio JIMS, Vasant Kunj 90.4 MHz.

advisoryCouncil.name: Mr. Soumyakant Dwivedy
bio: Mr. Soumyakant has over 20 years of experience in supply chain and operations with expertise in cross functional leadership, change management, implementing process improvements and skill development. He has exposure to Healthcare, Consumer Electronics, FMCG, Shipping and Manufacturing sectors. Currently, he heads the Regional Supply Chain Excellence & Analytics, Greater Asia/APAC Becton Dickinson, Singapore. Prior to this, he was heading the Supply Chain for BD South East Asia & India and also worked with Nokia, Philips, Cavinkare where he handled various supply chain/business operations roles. He has also led Global Health for South East Asia apart from Supply Chain responsibilities. Additionally, Mr. Soumyakant is an advisor at PPHF and focusses on building capacity in the area of health systems strengthening and support for ‘health, wellness and safety' of transport workers. He holds a mechanical engineering degree from BIT, Sindri and MBA from XIM, Bhubaneswar.

advisoryCouncil.name: Mr. Suresh Vedula
bio: Mr Suresh has over three decades of corporate experience in the IT/telecom sectors and has worked for brands such as Motorola, Nokia, Wipro and most recently led the Business development and Partnerships at Google India. He has built teams and led new business development in enterprise sales, retail channels and e-commerce. Along the way, he has developed expertise in complex contract negotiations, scaling businesses from scratch and mentoring people. An active investor in start-ups, he’s a visiting faculty at premier institutions such as IIMs. He holds an MBA from IIM-B and an engineering degree from NIT-K. Mr Suresh Vedula is a  certified life coach.

advisoryCouncil.name: Dr. Raj Shankar Ghosh
bio: Dr. Raj Shankar Ghosh is a physician with three decades of experience in policy, planning and delivery of public health programs. His primary interests are in climate health, primary health care, infectious diseases, and vaccine delivery. Dr. Ghosh is a founding member of the Quality, Equity, and Inclusiveness (QEI) initiative at Department of Management Studies, IIT Delhi

Dr. Ghosh has worked in West Bengal State Health Services as a Medical Officer in a Primary Health Centre, as a Regional Coordinator in the National Polio Surveillance Project of World Health Organization and as Director, Immunization for South Asian Region at PATH India office. His most recent assignment was as Senior Advisor, Immunization at the India office of Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Dr. Ghosh currently provides technical advice to national and international organizations on One Health, Climate Health, Disease Surveillance, and Immunization.
Dr Ghosh is a recipient of honorary Fellowship from Indian Public Health Association for his contribution to public health in the South Asian region.

advisoryCouncil.name: Nikhilesh Maity
bio: Mr. Nikhilesh Maity is a seasoned professional with 30 years of experience in the social sector, specializing in health and hygiene. Currently serving as the Director of Jan Shikshan Sansthan since 2003, he has made significant contributions to organizations such as Singbhoom Gram Unnayan Samiti, Shramjeevi Unnayan, Mind Fellowship of Priya, and KVGK (Usha Martin CSR). His expertise extends to skill training, having positively impacted thousands of lives in Jharkhand and Chhattisgarh. As a dedicated Board member, Mr. Maity brings valuable leadership and passion for social welfare to the organization.

advisoryCouncil.name: Dr. Laxmikant Palo
bio: Dr Laxmikant Palo is the Chief Executive Officer of PPHF with a strong track record of 29 years as a Program Leader, Technical Advisor of development programs across a diverse range of international organizations like Project HOPE, Save the Children, USAID, IntraHealth International, PATH, FHI360, and UK-AID. Dr Palo has successfully provided technical, fiscal, strategic and operations leadership in uniquely demanding environments. Dr Palo has extensive experience in program planning and management, evidence-based policy advocacy, partnership management, providing technical assistance to government and project implementing partners. His geographic expertise ranges from India and other parts Asia, to Africa, Europe and the United States. On the academic front, Dr Laxmikant has a Ph.D. in Public Health.

advisoryCouncil.name: Dr. Keith Kibirango MCIOF (Dip)
bio: Keith Kibirango is the Chief Executive of New Global Markets (NGM) Consulting, with over 20 years of experience in social impact and fundraising across the UK, Europe, and globally. A British Ugandan lawyer, he holds degrees from Makerere University and the London School of Economics, and has a career marked by a dedication to social justice, philanthropy, and leadership.Keith's experience spans roles in Uganda, where he led the Legal Aid Project of the Uganda Law Society, to the UK, where he pioneered major donor and fundraising programs at Tommy's, JUSTICE, and Save the Children UK, securing a landmark £10 million donation. Keith's board experience includes roles with Save the Children UK, Mothers2Mothers, and Comic Relief, engaging with global leaders and influencers to drive meaningful social change, solidifying his status as a transformative figure in international development and philanthropy.

advisoryCouncil.name: Dr. Rajiv Tandon
bio: Dr. Rajiv Tandon is a leading public health and nutrition expert and advocate in India, with over 40 years of active developmental and medical experience across a range of public health issues. Along with his training and clinical practice as a Paediatrician and Neonatologist for over two decades, he has led and shaped many civil society organisations and donors, large global, regional, and national programs and advocacy initiatives in the public health and social development space. Dr. Tandon has extensive experience and expertise on Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, and Child Health (RMNCH), Agriculture-Food and Nutrition Security, Neglected Tropical Diseases and Malaria (NTD&M), Vaccines and Health Technologies, and Health Systems Reforms. He has conceptualised, coordinated and participated within diverse, multi-stakeholder platforms and fora to push the policy and programmatic agendas, including the Coalition for Sustainable Nutrition Security in India, the Partnership for Maternal Newborn Child Health (PMNCH), the RMNCH+A Coalition, Neglected Tropic Diseases Coalition, Covid Catalytic Partnership, Parliamentarians for Malaria Elimination, Acute Encephalitis Syndrome TAG, South Asia Regional Coordinating Mechanism of the Global Fund, etc., leading to health policy reforms. Dr. Tandon has been closely associated with and has advised various global academic institutions on key initiatives, such as Harvard School of Public Health (Better Birth study), Stanford Center for International Development (Stanford India Health Policy Initiative), McGill Centre for the Convergence of Health and Economics (Whole of Society Convergent Innovation Platform), Washington University (Local Contextualised RUTF), KLE University (Maternal Newborn Registry and Postpartum Hemorrhage). He has been in the senior leadership of various civil society organisations and public health communities from global to national levels, actively growing them and facilitating greater technical rigour and quality, for equitable and sustainable impact. He has been the author of various scientific, peer-reviewed publications and has been recognised for these contributions to the field.

team.name: Akash Meena
bio: Akash has over 8 years of experience in the field of health and nutrition. He has worked in international NGOs including Action Against Hunger Foundation (ACF - AAHF), IPE Global Ltd., providing technical support to Indira Gandhi Matritva Poshan Yojana, and Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana. In this work, Akash has been honored by the SDM at the block level and has been honored by IPE Global at the state level. He has also worked for Zero Hunger project of WHP. He has the experience of working in tribal and rural belts.

team.name: Ajay Pal
bio: Ajay Pal, State Program Manager of Karnataka state has over 17 years of experience in project management, planning, implementation, monitoring and field level support to NGO’s. He has worked on public health programs with National and International development agencies in the state of Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Telangana, with focus on HIV/AIDS Prevention, Care and Support programs working with key population. He has managed Tsunami and flood relief programs. He holds M.Phil. in Psychiatric Social Work from NIMHANS, Bangalore and Masters in Social Work (Medical &. Psychiatry) from Loyola College, University of Madras

team.name: Alok Chandra Mohanty
bio: Alok Chandra Mohanty is a social, development and health sector professional having more than 30 years of working experience in various fields and operational areas. He possesses a rich profile of leading a number of large-scale projects being implemented and supported by the Government, International Agencies and Development Partners such as  National Health Mission (NHM), United Population Fund (UNFPA), United Nations Children’s Funds (UNICEF), etc. His areas of expertise range from systems strengthening, partnership building, policy advocacy, program implementation, capacity building to resource mobilization and project management. He has demonstrated ability in delivering results within timeline and significantly contributed in project expansion and scaling up in many occasions. He is a team player and has successfully handled large workforces effectively.

team.name: Dr Nalini Kaushik
bio: Dr Nalini is a seasoned public health expert with over 14 years of specialized experience in the pharmaceutical and medical device sectors, delivering services in health policy research, advocacy, regulatory & government affairs, and strategic communications.
She has provided strategic guidance to a diverse array of prestigious clients, including WHO-SEARO, ICMR, USAID, Sanofi, ADVAMED, Janssen Pharmaceuticals, Takeda, DSM, Abbott etc.

With her keen passion for women and child health she has extensively worked on subjects such as menstrual health, family planning, adolescent health and menopause. So far, she has trained 2000+ individuals, conducted several M&E studies and has curated India's first menopause policy discourse titled "Menopause Dialogue".

Dr Kaushik has foundational training in Dental Surgery; and later she received a Masters in Public Policy from National Law School of India University. She also holds a diploma in Global Health Diplomacy from University of Toronto and a Diploma in Menstrual Health and Wellness.

team.name: Tanmay Satpathy
bio: Tanmay Satapathy is a postgraduate professional with more than twenty years of social development experience. He has extensive professional exposure to various programs in the field of health programme management. During his professional career he has worked in multiple sectors - health, disaster management, irrigation and education. He is involved in and contributed to various projects by the Government as well as non-government organisations.

bio: Ms. Malhotra is a passionate public health professional with 18+ years international experience as a senior professional in public health working in both the private and public sectors.
Ms. Malhotra has extensive experience in advocacy, policy reform and health systems strengthening with a particular focus on expanding access to healthcare services in India and abroad.

Ms. Malhotra’s work across the globe including India, Bangladesh, Suriname, Mexico, Dubai, South Sudan is focused on non communicable diseases, nutrition, WASH, Solid Waste management and rare diseases has resulted in increased state funding for NCDs, the development of NCD training manuals for CHWs, Medical Officers and Para Medicals, monitoring of vaccination programs and key improvements in the national Rare Disease Policy. Ms Malhotra is a post graduate and certified diabetes educator and lactation consultant. She has completed South East Asia regional course on public health by AIIMS Delhi and PGI Chandigarh. She has also completed her fellowship in global policy, diplomacy and sustainability.

team.name: Dr Deepak Rohilla
bio: Deepak is a healthcare professional with over 10 years of experience in program management, strategic planning, and community health interventions. He holds a Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.), a Bachelor in Electrohomeopathy Medicine & Surgery (B.E.M.S.), and a two-year Diploma in Pharmacy. He has worked with international NGOs like World Vision India and TB Alert India on critical public health initiatives, including tuberculosis elimination. His expertise spans counseling, behavior change programs, government relations, data management, and advocacy. Deepak has also contributed to CSR projects, such as Child Survival India’s health and road safety intervention for truckers, where he played a key role in project coordination and community engagement. He began his career as a Volunteer Outreach worker at Mamta Organization and remains committed to driving impactful health programs.

team.name: Nitin Bhardwaj
bio: Nitin Bhardwaj has more than 5 years of experience in accounting, auditing, compliance & grant management. He has worked with CA firms like BHS & Co. & assisted development sector organization like John Snow India Private Limited, JSI R&T India Foundation, Intrahealth Internationa, Inc., Khalsa Aid Charitable Trust & National Thalassemia welfare Society.

team.name: Kuldeep Kispotta
bio: Mr. Kuldeep Kispotta is a Graphic Designer with 7 years of experience in Publication and Advertising. He graduated from Delhi University and holds a diploma in Graphic Design from Don Bosco Technical Institute, Okhla. Throughout his journey, he has honed his skills in creating outstanding designs for print media and brand identification. He is committed to learning new things and constantly enhancing his expertise. Proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and the Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator), he continues to evolve as a versatile and innovative designer.

team.name: Dr Laxmikant Palo
bio: Dr Laxmikant Palo is the Chief Executive Officer of PPHF with a strong track record of 29 years as a Program Leader, Technical Advisor of development programs across a diverse range of international organizations like Project HOPE, Save the Children, USAID, IntraHealth International, PATH, FHI360, and UK-AID. Dr Palo has successfully provided technical, fiscal, strategic and operations leadership in uniquely demanding environments. Dr Palo has extensive experience in program planning and management, evidence-based policy advocacy, partnership management, providing technical assistance to government and project implementing partners. His geographic expertise ranges from India and other parts Asia, to Africa, Europe and the United States. On the academic front, Dr Laxmikant has a Ph.D. in Public Health.

team.name: Dr Rajiv Tandon
bio: Dr. Rajiv Tandon is a leading public health and nutrition expert and advocate in India, with over 40 years of active developmental and medical experience across a range of public health issues. Along with his training and clinical practice as a Paediatrician and Neonatologist for over two decades, he has led and shaped many civil society organisations and donors, large global, regional, and national programs and advocacy initiatives in the public health and social development space.

Dr. Tandon has extensive experience and expertise on Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, and Child Health (RMNCH), Agriculture-Food and Nutrition Security, Neglected Tropical Diseases and Malaria (NTD&M), Vaccines and Health Technologies, and Health Systems Reforms. He has conceptualised, coordinated and participated within diverse, multi-stakeholder platforms and fora to push the policy and programmatic agendas, including the Coalition for Sustainable Nutrition Security in India, the Partnership for Maternal Newborn Child Health (PMNCH), the RMNCH+A Coalition, Neglected Tropic Diseases Coalition, Covid Catalytic Partnership, Parliamentarians for Malaria Elimination, Acute Encephalitis Syndrome TAG, South Asia Regional Coordinating Mechanism of the Global Fund, etc., leading to health policy reforms.

Dr. Tandon has been closely associated with and has advised various global academic institutions on key initiatives, such as Harvard School of Public Health (Better Birth study), Stanford Center for International Development (Stanford India Health Policy Initiative), McGill Centre for the Convergence of Health and Economics (Whole of Society Convergent Innovation Platform), Washington University (Local Contextualised RUTF), KLE University (Maternal Newborn Registry and Postpartum Hemorrhage). He has been in the senior leadership of various civil society organisations and public health communities from global to national levels, actively growing them and facilitating greater technical rigour and quality, for equitable and sustainable impact. He has been the author of various scientific, peer-reviewed publications and has been recognised for these contributions to the field.

team.name: Usman Siddiqui
bio: Usman brings in over 6 years of documentation experience and has worked for various non-profits. Skilled in audio-visual production, scripting, content creation, social media management and website management, he believes that stories are the best medium to communicate and connect

team.name: Pinky Dutta Medhi
bio: Pinky Dutta Medhi is a Rural Livelihood and Agri-Business Consultant with over 15 years of experience in North East India. Holding a Master's in Life Science from Guwahati University and trained in entrepreneurship by UNTAD, UN, she specializes in working with FPOs in North-Eastern States to boost farmer incomes and promote sustainable farming. Recognized for her impactful work, she received the "Successful Women Entrepreneur 2021" award from Ministry of Food Processing, Govt of India. Her focus includes strategic FPO development, enhancing rural livelihoods, and advising on agricultural policies.

team.name: Rajiv Kumar
bio: Rajiv Kumar is a dedicated development professional with over 26 years of experience in rural development, women empowerment, organic farming, solid waste management, and administration. He has worked extensively with leading organizations to implement high-impact interventions that empower vulnerable communities. His expertise spans program planning, stakeholder engagement, and policy advocacy, with a strong focus on livelihood generation and sustainable development. Rajiv has successfully led initiatives in women’s self-help group (SHG) formation, organic agriculture, biotechnology, and environmental sustainability. His analytical skills and deep understanding of rural economies and psychology have contributed to strengthening systems and improving service delivery in underserved regions. Passionate about social equity and inclusive growth, he remains committed to fostering community resilience and sustainable development.

team.name: Shashank Dwivedi
bio: Er. Shashank Dwivedi holds a bachelor’s degree in Information Technology and a Masters in Population studies from International Institution for Population studies [IIPS]. He has a work experience of 7 years with IT and Development sector across various thematic interventions including public health, social entitlement ,skill and livelihood ,public infrastructure development etc.He has handled the big dataset like DHS,census and NFHS and have knowledge in various statistical softwares i.e STATA,SPSS, R studio and MORTPAK .He has handled the big dataset like DHS,census and NFHS and have knowledge in various statistical software’s i.e STATA,SPSS, R studio and MORTPAK.He has  track record of planning, monitoring, analysing, and reporting programs for esteemed organizations like UNDP, FCDO, and others speaks volumes about your expertise in the field. His tenure at Phia Foundation, along with your academic journey at Jawaharlal Nehru University, Indira Gandhi National Open University, and Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, has equipped you with a solid foundation in data analysis, research, report writing, and project management.

team.name: Vaishali Pathak
bio: Ms. Vaishali Pathak is a nutritionist and a keen researcher. Her goal is to work towards improving the awareness among the Indian population regarding health and well-being. She has over 7 years of experience in this domain. She completed her PhD from the University of Delhi, where she worked to understand the various lifestyle factors affecting physical and mental health of employees from the private sector.

team.name: Rahul Nath
bio: Rahul Nath is a procurement, finance, and administration professional with nearly 11 years of experience working with reputed non-profit and development organizations such as Foundation of MSME Cluster, Pratham Education Foundation, World Vision India, and Child Fund International. Last serving as Assistant Manager – Procurement & Admin at the Foundation of MSME Cluster, he leads end-to-end procurement processes, vendor management, contract negotiations, compliance verification, and coordination with cross-functional teams. He ensures procurement activities align with budget availability and organizational policies. Previously, he held key roles in accounts, finance, and supply chain management, handling budgeting, donor reporting, internal and external audits, donor audits, statutory compliance (including TDS), MIS reporting, asset management, and vendor payments. Rahul holds a B.Com (Honors) degree from Vidyasagar University and possesses strong technical skills in SAP, Tally, Sun System, Coupa, Newton ERP, and MS Office. He is known for his strong coordination skills, vendor management expertise, compliance knowledge, and ability to effectively support field and central teams. He is a dedicated and performance-driven professional with strong communication skills and a solid background in procurement, finance, and administration within the development sector.

team.name: Vijay Singh
bio: Vijay Kumar Singh is an experienced development professional with a background in the pharmaceutical sector, rural development, and livelihood promotion. He has worked in different sectors focusing on community development, healthcare awareness, skill development, and sustainable livelihood initiatives. With strong experience in field operations and project implementation, he has contributed to improving rural livelihoods and supporting community empowerment through various development programs.

team.name: Aditya Kumar
bio: Aditya Kumar has more than 10 years of experience in financial accounting, statutory compliance, taxation, and audit operations, including preparing balance sheets according to applicable accounting standards, ledger scrutiny, and salary processing. His professional background spans both chartered accountancy practice and healthcare/diagnostics centers. Aditya has managed comprehensive accounting and statutory compliance for a diverse portfolio of entities—including companies, NGOs, and proprietary firms. His expertise includes direct and indirect taxation, finalizing and filing Income Tax and GST returns, TDS compliance, and tax audits. Additionally, he has hands-on experience with healthcare/diagnostics accounting and financial ERP platforms such as Tally Prime.
